svg.title: Test pyramid: 321 plugin tests across unit and property, Byzantine validators, end-to-end town runs, and one live real-LLM test
svg.desc: A test pyramid. Base: 262 unit and Hypothesis property tests. Then 51 Byzantine-validator tests. Then 8 end-to-end town runs. Apex: 1 live real-LLM test excluded from CI. Total 321 plugin tests, 1057 whole-repo.
svg.text: Test pyramid — 321 plugin tests (1057 whole-repo · pyright 0 · ruff clean)
Base = deterministic unit + Hypothesis property tests (quorum intersection, weight simplex, ε-bounds, partition safety);
apex = a real-LLM town run, live-marked so it never gates CI. Every layer runs the same ResonanceBFT protocol.
